newsitem.title: UK: UK PSBR 2.6 bln stg in November.
newsitem.headline: UK PSBR 2.6 bln stg in November.

text.p: UK public sector borrowing requirement data for November. Deficits unless noted (rep).
PSBR (in bln stg) NOV APR-NOV APR-NOV
NOTE- Privatisation proceeds in November were negligible, as was the case in November last year.
Consensus forecast was for a 2.7 bln stg PSBR in November.
The October public sector debt repayment was unchanged from the initial estimate of 4.4 billion stg.
Receipts of 900 million stg from the sale of Ministry of
Defence property scored as negative spending and reduced net departmental outlays.
The ONS said the December PSBR would include privatisation proceeds of about 250 million stg from the sale of residual share holdings.

Further increases in the stock of strippable gilts, with interest payments in June and December, will increase interest payments in these months. December interest payments are expected to be one billion stg over the previous year.
NOTE: The ONS rounded up figures to only one decimal place this month instead of three.
NOTE 2: Please note that the cumulative PSBR figures for the current and last financial year exclude privatisation proceeds.

The cumulative PSBR inclusive of privatisation proceeds totalled 13.9 billion stg for the April to November period this year. For the same period last year, the PSBR including privatisation proceeds totalled 22.4 billion stg.
The government's forecast for the 1996/97 PSBR, of 26.4 billion stg, includes privatisation proceeds.
